C9000022.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 022 (The weak inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture.; papers: 0,\infty)`$, divergence of $`\sum_q\phi(q)\psi(q)/q`$ implies $`\|qx-\gamma\|\lt \psi(q)`$ for infinitely many q, for almost every x. Numerators are unrestricted; no monotonicity or Diophantine condition on γ is needed.  [The Weak Inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer Conjecture; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_BC_UNROLL.statement: Every finite backward trace is bounded by the terminal carried product plus one nonnegative stopped capacity charge per step.

C_BC_RESTORE.statement: The actual good-mask harmonic condition and P0=rho*H give a uniform bound for the product of inverse ordinary factors at mismatch primes above P0.

C_DSC.statement: For each fixed real gamma and finite-valued nonnegative psi, divergence of sum_q phi(q)*psi(q)/q implies ||q*x-gamma||<psi(q) infinitely often for almost every x.

C_FIRST_JOIN.statement: The full broad and same-mask narrow first-sharing comparison bounds hold uniformly in the finite block, slot cap, and allowed prior history.

C_DIRECT_JOIN.statement: The static additional test and direct adjacent simultaneous-birth comparisons satisfy their quantitative first-join estimates.

C_RFJ_QUANT.statement: Under the stipulated retained-centre, good-mask, and admissible-history hypotheses, both remaining counts are O_k0(W^(201/200)); the oriented mixed roundoff improves to O(W^2). Constants are independent of block, history, and N_0.
